$comment: The events each eulogy of the 2004 editions names, as event mentions: the councils and synods, and other historical events with a Wikidata item (persecutions, wars, revolutions, invasions, sieges, schisms, epidemics). Each gives the phrase as printed in the Latin (la) and the Italian (it), either one when only that edition names the event, and the event's Wikidata item. The whole phrase is one mark; a place mark inside it goes (a council's phrase resolves to the city where it met, data/gazetteer.json), unless keep_places, when the place stays marked inside the event. where (default the text) and occurrence (from 1) place a phrase printed elsewhere or more than once. Read by scripts/extract_mentions.py; see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-01-event-mentions-design.md and docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-07-historical-event-mentions-design.md.
